$comment: Evidence map for Phase 30. Current executable coverage proves regional and localization contracts; durable locale registry/runtime deployment remains declared.

areas.area: Locale resolution respects authorization and language fallback
areas.requirement: Locales require language metadata, institutional policy takes precedence over user preference, and fallback cannot select unauthorized locales.

evidence.contains: resolves institutional policy before user preference
falls through when the top candidate is unauthorized

areas.area: RTL, Unicode, names, addresses and cultural conventions are safe
areas.requirement: Direction and Unicode safety are explicit, bidi overrides are detected, and cultural/name/address models do not impose universal conventions.

evidence.contains: rejects profiles that assume universal conventions

areas.area: Translations and localized content preserve approval, version and drift
areas.requirement: AI translations require human review, updates reset approval, terminology proposals do not silently apply, and content fallback/drift/governance are controlled.

evidence.contains: bumps version and resets approval on update
marks high-risk AI translations for human approval
proposes terminology changes without silently applying them
detects translation drift against source versions

areas.area: Jurisdiction, residency, timezone and calendar rules preserve history
areas.requirement: Jurisdiction chains, effective-dated rules, data transfer restrictions, timezone-aware events, calendars and holidays are explicit and versioned.

evidence.contains: builds and validates a jurisdiction chain
restricts sensitive data transfers to in-country

areas.area: Currency, tax, units, documents, communication and integrations are localized representations
areas.requirement: Regional formatting preserves source context, validates currencies/tax types, uses historical FX, and does not redefine domain truth.

evidence.contains: formats numbers and currency per locale

areas.area: Configuration, feature availability and country expansion are gated
areas.requirement: Specific configuration precedence, immutable rules, regional dependencies, readiness scores, pilots, support and SLAs are explicit.

evidence.contains: opens controlled regional pilots with monitoring

areas.area: Localization QA, connectivity adaptation, regional graph and events are bounded
areas.requirement: Locale matrices cover LTR/RTL, test runs and human review are recorded, limited networks adapt sync/offline behavior, regional graphs validate, and only known events publish.

evidence.contains: requires both LTR and RTL in the locale matrix
adapts sync on data-cost-aware limited networks

areas.area: Durable globalization registries and runtime projections are wired
areas.requirement: Locale, translation, jurisdiction, format and regional readiness records persist and are consumed by authorized runtime surfaces.
